questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to collect and sell Pokemon trading cards
Why video games are bad for children
Why the game Super Mario became so popular
How to become a famous streamer on YouTube
questions.why: Rob says they're talking about the iconic video game character Super Mario, and why the game is so popular.

questions.q: What does Georgina remember about her childhood?
options: Playing Super Mario or Sonic for hours
Never being allowed to play video games
Working in a shop that sold video games
Winning money in video game competitions
questions.why: She says she spent many hours playing Nintendo's Super Mario or Sega's Sonic the Hedgehog.

questions.q: What do the presenters say about video games today?
options: Only young children really play them now
They are much less popular than before
Most games are too expensive to buy
Gamers can win prizes and become stars
questions.why: They mention e-sports with considerable money, and streamers who have become celebrities.

questions.q: What was the video game market like in the early 1980s, especially in the US?
options: It was growing faster than ever
It was struggling
It was controlled by Sega
It had only a few games
questions.why: Georgina says in the 1980s the console market was struggling, particularly in the US.

questions.q: According to Keza MacDonald, what happened to the game ET on the Atari?
options: It became the best-selling game in America
It was only ever sold in Europe
It was so bad copies were buried
It was the first game to feature Mario
questions.why: She says it was so bad 'they ended up burying thousands of copies of it in the desert'.

questions.q: What does Keza say rescued the video game industry in the US?
options: The game ET
Cheaper consoles
Sonic the Hedgehog
Nintendo
questions.why: She says the video game boom was falling off a cliff 'and Nintendo is what rescued' it in the US.

questions.q: According to Keza, what makes Super Mario Bros. so enjoyable?
options: The joy of running and jumping
Its long and exciting story
Its realistic modern graphics
The chance to win real money
questions.why: She says 'it's running and jumping, and it's the joy of movement'.

questions.q: What does Rob think of the original game now?
options: It's too old and difficult to play today
It's still as good as it was back then
It's only fun for young children
It was never as good as people say
questions.why: He says he played it recently and 'it's still as good now as it was then'.
